description: Introduction and overview of the C-130 Hercules: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The C-130 Hercules is a four-engine turboprop tactical airlifter built by Lockheed, in continuous production since 1956 — the longest-running military aircraft production run in history. Over 2,500 have been built in dozens of variants: transports, gunships (AC-130), tankers, weather reconnaissance, and special-operations versions. Baseline facts: Four-turboprop tactical airlifter; in production since 1956; 2,500+ built by Lockheed in many variants..
